Когда ставить памятник после похорон?.hook: When to install a monument after a funeral?
Когда ставить памятник после похорон?.body: A monument is best installed no earlier than a year after the funeral, once the ground has settled and the base will be stable. A temporary cross or plaque can be placed right away.

Какой камень не боится ярославских мороз.hook: Which stone can handle Yaroslavl frosts?
Какой камень не боится ярославских мороз.body: For the Yaroslavl climate, Karelian gabbro diabase granite works best: it withstands frost, moisture and temperature swings. Marble looks beautiful but is less resistant to the weather in central Russia.

От чего зависит цена памятника?.hook: What decides the price of a monument?
От чего зависит цена памятника?.body: The price depends on size, shape, material and design. The company works without middlemen, so you pay only for the stone and the work.

Как быстро делают памятник?.hook: How fast is a monument made?
Как быстро делают памятник?.body: A standard monument takes from 3 days to make, depending on the complexity of the order. It is best to confirm the exact timing by phone.

Где вы устанавливаете памятники?.body: We install monuments at all cemeteries in Yaroslavl and the Yaroslavl region, with a branch in Danilov for the north of the region. Delivery and installation are included in the price of the order.

Почему без посредников честнее?.hook: Why is working without middlemen fairer?
Почему без посредников честнее?.body: The company has its own production in Yaroslavl and has worked since 1996. Without middlemen the price is fairer: you pay for the stone and the work.

Установка памятника бесплатно?.body: Installation is free when you buy a monument, and a grave slab is a gift with full payment of the order. The terms and dates of the offer are confirmed by our consultants.

Какую форму памятника выбрать?.body: Monuments can be vertical, horizontal or double. The shape depends on the size of the plot and the wishes of the family.

Что можно нанести на памятник?.hook: What can be engraved on a monument?
Что можно нанести на памятник?.body: A portrait and engraving can be added to a monument: the name, dates and an epitaph. A portrait needs a clear original photograph.

Как подобрать эпитафию?.body: An epitaph usually takes one or two lines. It is best to choose words that were close to the person and to avoid very long quotes.

Как мыть гранитный памятник?.hook: How to clean a granite monument?
Как мыть гранитный памятник?.body: Wash a granite monument with a soft sponge, warm water and a neutral cleaner. Abrasive powders and hard brushes leave scratches on the polish.

Что проверить у памятника весной?.hook: What to check on a monument in spring?
Что проверить у памятника весной?.body: In spring, once the snow has melted, check the base of the monument and the flower bed and clear away debris. In winter, do not chip ice off with metal tools.

Как проходит заказ памятника?.hook: How does ordering a monument work?
Как проходит заказ памятника?.body: Ordering starts with a call to discuss the material, size and design. Then the layout is agreed, the monument is made and it is installed at the cemetery.

Как выбрать качественный гранит?.body: When choosing granite, look for even color, smooth polish and no chips or cracks. We use granite from Karelian and Ural deposits.

Как продумать памятник на двоих?.hook: How to plan a monument for two?
Как продумать памятник на двоих?.body: It is convenient to plan a monument for two in advance: the size, space for the second name and a single style of design.
